title: Affine 48-byte to 64-byte matrix conversion
summary: Recovered 0x4271a0 register ABI, destination return, basis transpose, translation-first write order and four positive-zero last-column entries. Original float bit patterns are copied without arithmetic. Original callers use ECX destination and EDX source; a fastcall member preserves that register interface.
test_description: Differential original-reference comparisons over 17760 cases: float edge bit patterns and pseudorandom payloads, separate buffers, exact alias and every four-byte partial overlap across both directions; all rounding modes and FTZ/DAZ settings. Checks return identity, all 384 backing bytes, untouched memory, zero column, independent nonoverlap transpose/translation expectations, and unchanged MXCSR.
known_limits: No matching-byte claim. Original stack-cookie failure path is not reproduced; reference uses an initialized test-owned cookie.
Invalid pointers, inaccessible extents, concurrent mutation and byte-misaligned C++ objects are outside the defined portable interface.
Original type names and broader rendering semantics are unresolved. The bottom-right output is zero, not one, as directly observed in instructions.
